title: menuz keeps its own copies of what arca_swift issue 0003 moves into arca_swift, until arca_swift tags them
body:
## What

utilz-ic, 27 Oct 2026, on hv's word: the tracking issue for arca_swift's issue 0003, so that menuz's side of it is on Utilz's record.

arca_swift's issue 0003 (open, medium; filed 25 Oct 2026 by conflab-ic, on hv's ruling 3 in Conflab's ST0125 design) asks arca_swift to carry what each estate menu bar app copies today, and names menuz among the apps it hits. Everything it names but the guard is menuz's own code, and the guard is one menuz does not have:

- **The masthead row's image on macOS 27**: `drawsImage(_:)` (`native/macos/Menuz/Menuz/Services/Masthead.swift:49`, from Utilz issue 0073).
- **The app's icon in that row**: `setAppIcon(bundle:)` (`Masthead.swift:71`).
- **The XCTest-host check**: `AppDelegate.isTestHost(_:)` (`native/macos/Menuz/Menuz/MenuzApp.swift:53`), pinned by `native/macos/Menuz/MenuzTests/TestHostTests.swift`.
- **A single-instance guard**: menuz has none.

0003 asks arca_swift to carry the masthead fixes inside `MastheadRow` or the call that makes it, and the test-host check and the guard as one launch-time call that an adopter's `applicationDidFinishLaunching` makes first. Each adopter's copy goes once arca_swift ships its replacement.

## Measured

27 Oct 2026:

- menuz pins arca_swift at `minorVersion: 0.2.0` (`native/macos/Menuz/project.yml`, resolved at `f7742b1` in `Menuz.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved`) and takes ArcaMasthead and ArcaLogConsole from it.
- arca_swift's newest tag is `0.2.0` (`f7742b1`), and 0003 is open (read on GitHub; arca_swift's main at `f8af844`).
- No copy in menuz carries a pointer to 0003.

## Trigger

Nothing in Utilz starts until arca_swift tags a release that carries 0003's fixes. ic's todo 13 watches for that tag, and whoever learns of it first tells utilz-vc.

## Fix, once the trigger fires

A steel thread, its design read by vc before any code:

1. menuz's pin moves to the new tag, in `project.yml` and the tracked `Package.resolved`.
2. menuz deletes its copies and makes arca_swift's launch-time call first in `applicationDidFinishLaunching`, so it also gains the single-instance guard: a second launch activates the running copy and exits. The tests that pin the copies go, or move to what arca_swift ships.
3. The proof is the menuz-app dispatch on CI with Xcode 27.1, since only that dispatch proves a pin (this Mac's Swift 6.4 drops a dependency's warnings-as-errors), then menuz's suites and a hand run of the masthead row on macOS 27, each booked through vc.

## Placement

The first Utilz release cut after arca_swift's tag. No earlier Utilz release waits for it (see Release).

Size: S to M once the trigger fires; nothing now.

## Release (molt-vc with the pen, 27 Oct 2026)

molt-vc, holding the pen while hv is away, chose option (a), as utilz-vc recommended: 2.14.5 does not wait for 0114. 0114 rides the first Utilz release cut after arca_swift tags a release that carries 0003's fixes, and stays open, deferred on the record, until then. hv can overrule on return.

At the ruling, arca_swift's newest tag is 0.2.1 (tag object 7b9ce515, on commit ffdff0ab, ArcaLogConsole's WP-11), which is main's head. It carries none of 0003's fixes: 0003 is open, and the only commit on main that names it is its filing, f8af844.
